Can you keep an overview in a busy operational environment, bring structure to your tasks and make the right priorities when plans change? Do you enjoy working with people, taking responsibility and finding solutions?

Blue Water Shipping is looking for a dedicated Port Agent to join our Cruise & Port Agency team in Greve. As a Port Agent, you will become part of our 24/7 duty setup, acting as the link between our customers, vessels, ports, authorities, suppliers and other stakeholders. Flexibility is important part of the position, and it requires working outside normal office hours in connection with vessel operations, including early mornings, evenings, nights and weekends.

**About The Role

**As part of the team, you will be involved in planning, coordinating and following vessel calls from the initial preparations until the vessel has departed again. The role combines office-based planning and administration with hands-on operational work at vessels and terminals. You will work with a broad variety of vessels, including cruise ships, cargo vessels and navy vessels calling at Danish ports. The role is primarily based in Greve, but occasional work in Copenhagen is required, as Copenhagen is a major part of the daily operation.

Following your training and as your experience develops, you will take responsibility for coordinating your own vessel calls and daily operations, always with experienced colleagues and managers available for support and sparring. You will act as the customer’s local representative and help ensure that each port call is handled safely, professionally and according to the agreed operational plan.

**Your primary responsibilities will include:

**

• Coordination and handling of vessel port calls

• Planning and coordination of daily port operations

• Daily communication with vessels, customers, ports, authorities and suppliers

• Attendance of vessels and operations at the pier when required

• Handling vessel clearances and relevant documentation

• Coordination of crew changes, transportation and other crew-related services

• Arranging services, supplies, spare parts and other vessel requirements

• Customer invoicing and administrative follow-up

• Handling changing operational requirements and finding solutions when plans change

• Supporting port calls in other Danish ports when required

**Who Are You

**Previous experience in ship agency, shipping or a similar operational role is an advantage, but not a requirement. We are also open to candidates with transferable experience from other service-oriented or operational environments. Most importantly, you are reliable, service-minded, proactive and motivated to learn.

We are looking for someone who:

• Takes ownership and follows tasks through

• Is proactive, solution-oriented and adaptable

• Remains calm and structured under pressure

• Communicates confidently and professionally with different stakeholders

• Works well both independently and as part of a team

• Enjoys a fast-paced, international environment

• Has an interest in shipping, port operations and the maritime industry

You should have strong written and spoken English skills, be comfortable with MS Office and new IT systems, hold a valid Category B driving licence, and be able to travel within Denmark and occasionally abroad.

**What We Offer

**At Blue Water Shipping, you will become part of an informal working environment with experienced colleagues and a strong focus on cooperation, responsibility and professional development.

You will have the opportunity to learn the port agency profession through hands-on experience and daily sparring with colleagues and managers.

We offer:

• A varied working day with responsibility and operational challenges

• Hands-on experience within the international shipping and cruise industries

• Training and continuous professional development

• The opportunity to gradually take responsibility for your own vessel calls and customers

• Close cooperation with experienced colleagues across Blue Water Shipping

• Exposure to international customers, vessels, ports and maritime professionals

• A strong community where cooperation, commitment and team spirit are important

**Contact

**If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Pernille Marcussen, Manager, Cruise & Port Agency, at +45 42124613 or pmar@bws.dk.

Apply as soon as possible, as we review and interview on an ongoing basis.

What we do – Together we create solutions

We are a proud family-owned company, founded in Denmark in 1972, and a global provider of all logistics services within modern supply chain management. Our value foundation is still thriving today, driven by a pronounced entrepreneurial spirit and sound business practices. Therefore, our employees are offered a strong professional environment with great freedom, ensuring our customers the best service. Blue Water Shipping is represented by more than 2,700 employees worldwide, combining a strong global network with local expertise, enabling us to offer complete and tailored solutions for any shipping need anywhere in the world.

****Job Description:

****Are you ready to drive change, foster a culture of commercial excellence, and lead strategic transformation projects? As the Regional Perfo & Transformation Manager at Satair, you will act as the primary representative for the Commercial Process, Performance & Transformation (ASCX) team in your region. You will bridge the gap between regional teams and the central ASCX pillars of processes, performance, data analytics, and automation to support Satair's commercial objectives. We are looking for a structured, results-oriented leader who can influence without authority and advocate for the region's needs within a complex, shared Airbus ecosystem.

**What The Job Is

**You will report to the Head of Commercial Data Analytics (HO ASCXY) and integrate into a multi-disciplinary team spread across the globe. In this role, you will serve as the regional node for a centralized cross-functional team, meaning you will not have direct reports but will lead by influence across regional commercial teams, account directors, and operations.

Your main responsibilities:

• Regional Commercial Project Portfolio Leadership: Accountable for the regional commercial project portfolio's financial impact and performance metrics, leading transformation projects using LBIP and Agile methodologies.

• Regional AOS Roadmap Execution: Take accountability for the successful implementation of the AOS (Airbus Operating System) regional roadmap in alignment with ASCX and the Regional Managing Director.

• Regional Representation & Connectivity: Act as a critical connector between regional teams and ASCX, representing ASCX in the Regional Customer Satisfaction Review Board (R-CSRB) and other commercial forums.

• Culture & Continuous Improvement: Proactively drive a culture of creativity, commercial excellence, and continuous improvement by identifying and addressing systemic "irritants".

Travel days to be expected are approximately 30% (domestic and international).

**How You Will Contribute To The Team

**We are looking for a proactive professional with an excellent problem-solving mindset and an ability to translate data into actionable insights. You must possess a keen understanding of business issues, key stakeholders, and external dynamics which inform priority setting.

You must hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field, accompanied by 5-10 years of proven experience leading cross-functional, regional, and global continuous improvement and transformation projects in a complex setting. A strong understanding of aviation aftermarket commercial operations is highly preferred, as are additional certifications in process improvement methodologies (e.g., Six Sigma, Lean). You will thrive in this role if you possess a high degree of agility in learning, exceptional communication and presentation abilities, and a proactive "can-do attitude". Because you will be networking globally, an excellent command of both written and spoken English is required, while proficiency in a secondary language relevant to the assigned region is preferred.

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

**About SATAIR

**Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 12 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 2,000 people supporting a $3.9 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**What do we offer at SATAIR?

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:

Financial Benefits: Competitive salary, Employee Stock Ownership Program, Success sharing, Health insurance, Group accident insurance, Employee discounts to local businesses

Employee Health and Wellbeing: On-site gym, App-based health & wellbeing platform, Amazing canteen at a subsided price, Massage scheme

Learning and Development: Airbus Leadership University, Large number of e-learning and training offers for personal and professional development, Promotion of professional development (e.g. postgraduate studies, technician training), Possibility of mentoring, Gain international experience

Work-life blend and life phase support: Possibility to work remotely, 4 care days, Senior days, Working from home policy (2 days remote per week)

**Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

**Please send us your application as soon as possible to get the opportunity to become part of an exceptional global team!

We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

****Position Overview

**Autodesk Consulting is looking for a Business Consultant to join our Northern Europe team. This remote role supports strategic customers across the region.

This is a senior individual contributor role combining business consulting, AECO industry expertise and executive advisory. You’ll work with some of Autodesk’s largest customers to shape transformation strategies, define target operating models, and develop business cases and roadmaps that deliver measurable business outcomes.

You’ll advise senior leaders, structure complex business challenges and lead strategic advisory engagements from discovery through executive decision-making. While you won’t configure or implement solutions, you’ll understand how Autodesk and complementary technologies fit within customers’ broader business and technology ecosystems, partnering with technical specialists to turn strategy into actionable delivery plans.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Build trusted relationships with customer executives, business leaders and transformation teams, acting as a strategic advisor throughout the engagement

• Understand customer objectives, challenges and operating context to define outcome-driven transformation strategies

• Assess operating models, business processes, organizational capabilities, data and digital workflows to identify opportunities for improvement

• Define target-state operating models, transformation roadmaps, business cases, success measures and benefits realization plans

• Lead executive workshops, facilitate decision-making and align stakeholders across complex organizations

• Advise customers on how Autodesk and complementary AECO technologies support business outcomes through effective workflows, data management and interoperability

• Identify and prioritize opportunities for data, automation and AI based on business value, organizational readiness, governance and adoption

• Partner with Solution Architects, technical consultants and customer-facing teams to shape advisory engagements, validate strategic recommendations and develop credible delivery roadmaps

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• Substantial experience in AECO, management consulting or business transformation, with a proven track record of independently leading complex strategy and transformation engagements

• Deep expertise in at least one of the following: construction, infrastructure, engineering consultancy, utilities, or a closely related project-based, asset-intensive industry

• Strong working knowledge of Autodesk technologies or comparable AECO tool ecosystems, with the ability to discuss capabilities, workflow fit, data, interoperability and business value. Hands-on implementation expertise is not required

• Strong understanding of operating models, organizational change, governance, business cases and benefits realization

• Practical understanding of data-centric workflows, enterprise systems, automation, responsible AI and technology adoption

• Ability to lead through influence across cross-functional and international teams, with excellent communication and executive presentation skills

• Fluent English is required. Dutch and other European languages are highly valued

• Willingness to travel to customer meetings and Autodesk events across Northern Europe (up to 50%)

• Proven experience advising executives, structuring complex problems, facilitating high-stakes workshops and driving decisions

**Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Netcompany Banking Services

Do you want to have an influence on home furnishing trends across multiple countries? As Head of Range and Design at JYSK, you will define how our products look, feel and work together – from sleep and furniture to textiles and home décor.

You will own the vision and direction for JYSK’s overall product universe, establishing the design DNA that connects our products across categories. By translating our brand, trends, customer insights and commercial ambitions into a clear design direction and compelling collections, you will make it easier for customers to create an affordable Scandinavian home.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You will join an international retail company with high ambitions, short decision-making processes and a strong focus on results. Based at JYSK Head Office in Aarhus, Denmark, you will work closely with colleagues across the organisation to turn creative ideas into products that reach customers across countries.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• Leadership responsibility for a dedicated three-person team, with opportunities to develop the team

• Close involvement in product development, supplier partnerships and emerging home furnishing trends

• A cross-functional working environment where creative ideas are balanced with customer needs and commercial objectives

• A results-oriented culture built on trust, teamwork and freedom with responsibility

• A straightforward working environment where ideas can quickly become action

• Opportunities for professional and personal development, along with attractive employee benefits

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As Head of Range and Design, you will own and develop JYSK’s overall design direction and collection architecture across product categories. You will ensure that our Scandinavian design DNA is reflected consistently in our collections, with colours, materials, shapes, functionality, quality and packaging working together to create a recognisable customer experience. Balancing creative ambition with customer insights and commercial priorities, you will turn the design vision into compelling, commercially successful products.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Developing collection architecture and design briefs in close collaboration with Category Management and suppliers

• Using customer insights, sales data and profitability to guide design decisions and strengthen range performance

• Presenting design concepts and recommendations to stakeholders, aligning creative ideas with commercial priorities

• Collaborating with Marketing, E-Commerce, Visual Merchandising and Sales & Expansion on photography, social media, campaigns and the overall customer experience

Besides the above, you will lead and develop the three-person Design team, setting clear priorities, providing constructive feedback and fostering a culture of creative excellence, collaboration and commercial awareness. You will participate in range meetings, trade fairs and supplier visits in Denmark and abroad, travelling approximately 30–40 days per year to stay up to date with emerging trends and bring new inspiration into JYSK.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a colleague who combines a strong design vision with commercial understanding and the ability to translate creative ideas into successful products across a broad product range.

Ideally, you bring:

• Solid experience in design, product development, range management or category management within an international retail, brand or lifestyle business, with a strong track record of developing product concepts or collections

• The ability to define a clear design direction and translate it into practical design briefs and priorities

• A strong understanding of Scandinavian design, including colours, materials, functionality and visual consistency

• A data-driven approach to decision-making, using customer insights, sales data and profitability to guide design choices

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build relationships and create alignment across functions

• Experience in leading and developing colleagues, setting clear priorities and fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous development

You will become part of our Global Total Rewards team of five colleagues. Together, we support Head Office, 10 Distribution Centres across Europe and more than 3,400 stores in 29 countries.

• Ensuring high-quality employee master data through ongoing controlling and follow-up

• Analysing market data and supporting the development and maintenance of global pay ranges

• Contributing to the development of tools that make HR data easy to analyse and visualise

You enjoy working with data and getting the details right, but you are also curious about the bigger picture behind the numbers. You take responsibility for your tasks, ask questions when something does not add up and enjoy finding better ways of doing things.

You do not need many years of experience. What matters to us is that you bring a strong analytical mindset, curiosity and a willingness to learn and contribute.

• Works in a structured and analytical way with an eye for detail

• Is an advanced Excel user, while experience with SAP and BI tools is an advantage

• Takes initiative and enjoys working both independently and together with others

• Communicates confidently with colleagues across functions, countries and cultures

• Is fluent in written and spoken English

**You will:

• Set and implement the strategic and operational direction for EEBA so new lead drug candidates enter FHD with competitive, de-risked molecular expression, PK and ADME profiles.

• Oversee core deliverables in molecular microbial expression, bioanalysis, PK and ADME for the protein and peptide research portfolio and cross-area strategic projects.

• Own operational efficiency and capacity management, prioritising the FHD critical path activities and aligning mitigations with key stakeholders.

• Lead cross-functional collaboration across Research, CMC/GMS and external partners, acting as a key liaison to keep projects progressing.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory and ethical standards and support the digital strategy through robust data management and AI applications.

• Drive the team to set benchmark for world-class expertise and operational excellence, building and sustaining the capabilities needed to deliver on portfolio ambitions and strategic priorities.

• Proven experience leading leaders and managing cross-functional, high-performing research teams and strategic tasks.

jobs.description:
Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions is looking for a Senior Financial Controller to join our office in Copenhagen.

Team

You will be a part of a team consisting of five skilled financial professionals and will support our financial strategy to align with CIP FS’ ambitious long-term goals.

You will engage senior stakeholders to provide crucial financial insights across our platform companies and regions.

Role

Reporting to the VP of Global Controlling and Financial Reporting, you will contribute to the consolidation of the group’s financial statements and related reporting processes. You will be responsible for ensuring high-quality financial reporting and compliance with relevant accounting standards, and for supporting the business with accurate and timely insights.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Monthly controlling of accounts including cost controlling, balance sheet controlling and intercompany (IC) controlling

• Prepare and analyze consolidated financial statements and management reports

• Driving improvements in reporting processes and financial controls

• Collaborate with finance teams across the organization to ensure best practices in group reporting

• Close cooperation with the global capability center (shared service center)

• Oversight and controlling of service provider activities and point of contact for local service providers responsible for finance and corporate matters

• Act as a contact for auditors and internal stakeholders

You

You have an MSc in Economics or Finance and 3-5 years of full-time experience in audit, financial controlling, or consultancy from a Big4 firm. You also have experience in consolidation and are motivated by building best practices, solving complex issues and developing the finance function.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• Comprehensive knowledge of cost accounting and controlling

• Advanced analytical skills and attention to detail

• Effective time management, with the ability to prioritize assignments and manage short deadlines

• Solid communication skills and ability to collaborate across functions

• Curious and self-driven

• Danish GAAP and consolidation principles knowledge

• Fluency in English, both spoken and written

• Experience with Business Central and OneStream is an advantage

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

CIP Fund Solutions

CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Software Tester who can drive testing activities across complex digital solutions. You will be responsible for planning, coordinating, executing, and following up on testing efforts while working closely with business stakeholders, developers, product owners, and other teams.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, can switch context between multiple initiatives during the day, and enjoys taking ownership of quality assurance from requirements through delivery.

While the primary focus is manual testing, experience with test automation or a strong interest in helping establish and expand automation capabilities is considered an advantage.

**Key Responsibilities

**Manual Testing

• Create and maintain comprehensive test plans and test strategies.

• Execute functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end tests.

• Validate user interfaces, user experience, usability, and business workflows.

• Test across multiple browsers, devices, systems, and environments.

• Verify bug fixes and perform regression testing to ensure overall solution quality.

• Test applications, websites, APIs, databases, and system integrations.

• Understand and validate business requirements, business rules, technical requirements, workflows, and processes.

• Document findings, defects, risks, and recommendations clearly and effectively.

Test Coordination & Stakeholder Management

• Drive testing activities across projects and releases.

• Coordinate testing efforts with developers, Product Owners, business stakeholders, and external partners.

• Facilitate alignment on testing scope, priorities, risks, and release readiness.

• Ensure testing activities are tracked, communicated, and followed through to completion.

Automation (Preferred)

• Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts.

• Identify suitable test scenarios and processes for automation.

• Execute automated test suites and analyse results.

• Maintain stable, reusable, and scalable automated tests.

• Work with automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar tools.

• Contribute to building and improving the organization's automation capabilities.

Qualifications & ExperienceWe are looking for someone who has:

• Solid experience in manual software testing.

• Experience creating test plans and coordinating testing activities.

• Strong understanding of software development lifecycles and quality assurance processes.

• Experience testing web applications, APIs, integrations, and backend systems.

• Knowledge of, or practical experience working with, ISTQB or TMAP testing frameworks.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Ability to independently drive testing activities and follow up on actions.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and switch context when needed.

Nice to HaveThe following are considered advantages but are not required:

• Hands-on experience implementing or expanding test automation.

• Experience working within a microservices architecture.

• Familiarity with Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, and database querying.

• Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and modern development practices.

• Certified in ISTQB or TMAP.

You Might Have a Background As

• Software Tester / QA Engineer

• Manual Tester

• Technical Product Owner with testing experience

• Software Developer with a passion for quality assurance

• Test Automation Engineer looking for a role with strong business engagement

SmallClaims is a legal tech company that recovers small, valid claims of up to €25,000 through the courts. Claims that businesses write off today because pursuing them costs more than they are worth. Our AI agents run the whole process, from legal assessment and settlement to filing, judgment and enforcement, while our in-house lawyers quality-assure the work and appear in court. That has cut manual case handling from over 15 hours to about 1.5 hours per case. We have handled 5,000+ cases, win 90%+ in court and serve 500+ Danish customers. Case intake has grown more than 370% since 2023, and we have just raised €2M from Vendep Capital to grow in Europe. Now we are growing the engineering team.

**THE ROLE

**Full-time, in-house. You take ownership of your own areas within our AI service (Python/FastAPI, LLM pipelines) and our back-office platform, the tool our case managers and lawyers run the operation on. Ideas take form together with the team, product specialists and the CTO. You take them from there, end to end across the stack: shape, build, ship, verify, follow up.

**What You’ll Work On

**

• Own parts of and build features in our AI service: LLM orchestration with structured outputs, tool calling, and complex agentic workflows.

• Build the back-office platform our case managers and lawyers use every day, and talk to them to find out what they really need.

• Set up and improve evals and observability, so we know our agents are right before we scale them.

• Ship and run what you build, from staging to production on AWS, with tests and CI as a habit.

**What We Work With

**

• Stack: Laravel/PHP, Next.js, Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS, Google.

• How we build: Coding agents are part of daily work here. We expect you to be ahead of the curve on building with AI, not catching up to it.

**Who You Are

**

• 3+ years building and operating software in production, from a startup, a bigger company, open source or other serious project.

• You think like a product owner. You want responsibility and ownership, and you take a complicated problem to a shipped feature.

• You are good with data: you understand complex data sets and data pipelines, and you can build with them, visualise them and explain them.

• You hold strong opinions lightly. You are direct in disagreement, but easy to work with after the decision.

• You communicate directly and are honest about mistakes. You can talk to real users and are comfortable with shifting priorities.

• You love building, love learning, and are curious about the domain itself: the legal process, not just the tech.

**Experience And Skills

****Must have

**

• Strong backend development, incl. background jobs, auth models and API design.

• Solid relational database experience (Postgres/SQL or similar): schema design, migrations, performance.

• Hands-on LLM building in production, not just demos: orchestration, structured outputs, tool calling, evals, tracing, prompt design, injection.

• Works daily with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, opencode or similar), knows their strengths and limits, and stays up to date.

• Testing as a habit: feature and end-to-end tests, CI, verifying your own work through staging to production.

• Cloud and deployment literacy (AWS or similar, Docker, CI/CD). You can operate what you ship.

**Nice to have

**

• Python/FastAPI, Laravel/PHP or Next.js specifically.

• Production migration: third-party service changes, database moves, major-version upgrades, data backfills.

• Operating AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) and Linux servers hands-on.

• Eval or observability tooling for agentic workflows.

• Integrations where no documented API exists: webhooks, browser extensions, automation, scraping.

• Legaltech, fintech or another regulated domain.

**What We Offer

**

• Real ownership of core parts of the AI platform in a small team that ships every week.

• Close work with the CTO, product specialists and the lawyers who use what you build.

• Our base is the office in Copenhagen, but regular remote work is fine

**How To Apply

**Apply via The Hub with a short intro, your CV, GitHub and links to things you have built: apps, side projects, something you shipped at work. Next, we send you our skills checklist as a self-assessment plus a few short written questions, then interviews with the team, then an offer. We keep the process short and give you a clear answer at every step.

Use AI to change how Orifarm’s commercial teams analyze, report and decide. We are looking for a senior insights professional who builds it, proves it and brings colleagues along

About the job

In this role, you will drive the change in how we work with data and insight; first in our own reporting and analysis, then across the commercial organization, together with colleagues in the markets, Finance and IT. We are looking for someone with natural curiosity who knows how to use modern technology to turn data into business insights, in a streamlined way, across the commercial organization.

You will:

• Lead the commercial transformation of our reporting and analysis (monthly market and commercial reporting, portfolio reviews, ad hoc requests) with AI: not just faster, but fundamentally better and less manual

• Build practical AI workflows and assistants, using approved tools such as Claude and Copilot, that work across multiple, large datasets, e.g. internal sales, profitability, market, CRM and pricing data, in close collaboration with the AI Office

• Accelerate the use of AI across the commercial organization, turning enterprise AI capabilities and principles into business value

• Define the commercial data and insight requirements needed to make AI use cases successful, working with the AI Office, IT, Finance and data owners on the appropriate data foundation

• Apply Orifarm’s AI governance and quality guardrails to commercial use cases, including validation and appropriate human review of AI-supported management output

You will report to the Director of Commercial Excellence & Insights and become part of the Market Insights & Support team, working closely with the commercial leadership and our AI office. This is a senior individual contributor role, based in Odense or Copenhagen, with a hybrid work model.

Who are you?

You are a commercially minded professional with 5+ years of experience in business analysis, commercial insights, reporting or business transformation. You understand how to turn complex data into clear recommendations that support decisions and improve commercial performance. Experience from the pharmaceutical industry is not required, as we can teach you the industry.

You are confident working with multiple, large datasets and tools such as Excel and Power BI, and you know AI’s limits well enough to validate its output. You use generative AI as a practical business tool to strengthen analysis, simplify workflows and improve the quality of insights, and you can show examples of where it has changed real work. You work within Orifarm’s approved tools and data-security guidelines and collaborate closely with Finance, IT and other specialists

Equally important, you are a strong communicator and change facilitator. You explain complex topics simply, build trust quickly and help colleagues, including senior stakeholders, adopt new ways of working. You are pragmatic, curious and quality-minded, with sound commercial judgement. You know when human review is essential, and you are not afraid to say “not yet” when the output is not good enough.

You are fluent in English. Danish is not required.

Who are we?

You will join a small, close team that supports the commercial organization with insight, data and systems, and sits right next to the commercial leadership team, so your work is seen and used. We are six colleagues including you, working closely together in a direct, hands-on and informal way. Orifarm has a flat structure and short paths to decision-makers.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are 2,300 employees united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of making affordable medicine accessible.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.
